name: authors-forge
description: Author's Forge — durable, local-first AI publishing studio foundation.

scripts.build: rm -rf .forge-build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && rm -rf dist && cp -R .forge-build dist && cp -R public dist/public
scripts.verify: npm run build && node --test test && npm run completion && npm run test:browser && npm run test:browser:mobile
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node scripts/studio-browser-acceptance.js && node scripts/studio-context-browser-acceptance.js && node scripts/studio-kdp-preflight-browser-acceptance.js && node scripts/studio-recovery-browser-acceptance.js && node scripts/guided-journal-browser-acceptance.js && node scripts/specialized-creation-browser-acceptance.js && node scripts/specialized-creation-finishing-browser-acceptance.js && node scripts/specialized-creation-comic-browser-acceptance.js
scripts.test:browser:mobile: npm run build && node scripts/studio-mobile-acceptance.js && node scripts/specialized-creation-mobile-acceptance.js
